title: RS_SRID
description: Returns the SRID of a raster.
kernels:
  - returns: integer
    args: [raster]
---

See [Coordinate Reference Systems](../../concepts/crs.md) for how SedonaDB represents and compares CRS.

`RS_SRID` returns `0` both when the raster has no CRS and when it has a CRS with
no authority code, such as a custom WKT or PROJJSON definition. The SRID is a
lossy integer view of a CRS: `RS_SetSRID(raster, RS_SRID(other))` clears the CRS
when `other` carries a custom definition. Use `RS_CRS` and `RS_SetCRS` to read
and carry the full definition.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT RS_SRID(RS_Example());
```
